fact: On 16 February 2026 Chad's National Assembly approved by 160 votes to 1 the bill ratifying ordinance n°001/PR/2026 of 22 January 2026 reforming ANSICE, whose objectives include bringing artificial intelligence into the state's regulatory field.
title: L'Assemblée nationale approuve la réforme de l'ANSICE, un pas vers le numérique de demain
